paragraphs.description: Paragraph list; string entries expand to a one-run paragraph.

text.description: Single-paragraph shorthand; expands to one paragraph on stringify.

break.description: Marks a soft line break (a:br) within a paragraph's children.

TextCapitalization.description: Case effect: "all" ALL CAPS, "small" Small Caps, "none".

baseline.description: Baseline offset as integer percent (positive = superscript, negative = subscript).

outline.description: a:ln. `true` emits a sane default; a full OutlineOptions round-trips.

shadow.description: a:effectLst (EG_EffectProperties). `true` emits a default outer shadow; a full EffectListOptions round-trips.

size.description: Font size in points. Serialized as OOXML a:sz (hundredths of a point).

smtClean.description: `@smtClean` — smart tag clean flag (XSD default true).

underlineFill.description: EG_TextUnderlineFill — underline fill. `true` = a:uFillTx (follow the text fill); a FillOptions = a:uFill.

underlineLine.description: EG_TextUnderlineLine — underline line. `true` = a:uLnTx (follow the text line); an OutlineOptions = a:uLn.

text.description: a:t — display text (often a placeholder such as "‹#›" or "1/27/13").

TextFont.description: A script typeface. A bare string is the typeface only; the full object carries panose/pitchFamily/charset for embedded font metrics.

TextFontOptions.description: Single font slot — a:latin / a:ea / a:cs / a:sym.

referenceId.description: Internal placeholder key ("{hlink:N}" → "N"); preserved across parse → stringify.

slide.description: Internal slide target, 1-based slide number (mutually exclusive with url); emitted as r:id → slideN.xml + action="ppaction://hlinksldjump". PPTX only — other formats reject the field at generate time.

url.description: External URL target (mutually exclusive with slide).

TextListStyleOptions.description: A bare — a:defPPr plus up to 9 outline levels. The shape of a:lstStyle inside a txBody, p:notesStyle, and p:defaultTextStyle.

defaultParagraph.description: a:defPPr — defaults applied before any level.

ext.description: Trailing a:extLst verbatim inner XML; `""` preserves a bare <a:extLst/>.

levels.description: Levels 1-9; index 0 = lvl1pPr. `null` omits the level (JSON form of an undefined array slot — the position still pins the level number).

defaultRunProperties.description: a:defRPr — default run properties for the paragraph.

ext.description: Verbatim inner XML of a:extLst (last child per).

lineSpacingPercent.description: Line spacing as a percentage (100 = single).

spaceAfter.description: Space after a paragraph in points (a:spcAft/a:spcPts).

spaceAfterPercent.description: Space after a paragraph as a percentage (a:spcAft/a:spcPct).

spaceBefore.description: Space before a paragraph in points (a:spcBef/a:spcPts).

spaceBeforePercent.description: Space before a paragraph as a percentage (a:spcBef/a:spcPct).

tabStops.description: a:tabLst — explicit tab stops (emitted after bullets, before defRPr).

TextProperties3DOptions.description: dgm:txPr — a choice of 3D text treatments (EG_Text3D).

flatText.description: Flatten text to a plane at this z coordinate, EMU (a:flatTx `@z`).

shape3d.description: 3D shape properties for the label text (a:sp3d).

emptyProperties.description: The source carried a bare `<a:rPr/>` with no attributes or children. Round-trip marker only — re-emits the empty element instead of dropping it (element presence is part of the source's fidelity).

smtClean.description: `@smtClean` — smart tag clean flag (XSD default true).

TextShapePreset.description: Preset text shape — the warp geometry applied to a text body (a:prstTxWarp `@prst`).

ThemeOverrideOptions.description: Theme override (a:themeOverride /) — a per-part subset of the theme.

lineReference.description: Line reference (a:lnRef) into the theme style matrix

TileAlignment.description:
Tile alignment within the shape.

Specifies the anchor position of the first tile relative to the shape.

TileFlipMode.description:
Tile flip mode for tiling images.

Specifies whether the image is flipped along the x-axis, y-axis, both axes, or not at all when tiling.

TileOptions.description:
Options for tile fill mode.

Configures how an image is tiled (repeated) to fill a shape.

alignment.description: Alignment of the first tile within the shape

tx.description: Horizontal offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

ty.description: Vertical offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

amount.description: Amount in percentage points (0 to 100). Default 0.

TransitionDirection.description: Slide-transition motion direction; diagonal corners like "leftUp" apply to cover/pull, "in"/"out" to circle/plus/wedge/diamond.

data.description: Audio content: base64 string, data URL, or raw bytes.

type.description: Audio container format — becomes the media part extension.

TransitionType.description: Slide-change effect: "newsflash" spinning blur, "plus" plus-shaped reveal, "wedge" wedge-shaped wipe, "comb" comb-tooth reveal, "randomBar" random bars.

numberFormat.description: Number format applied to the trendline label (c:numFmt formatCode).

TrendlineType.description: Trendline fit; see period/order for the moving-average and polynomial degrees.

UniversalMeasure.description: Measurement string: number followed by a unit (mm, cm, in, pt, pc, pi or px).

animateLevel.description: Animate by level or from center (dgm:animLvl `@val`).

animateOne.description: Animate siblings one by one or as a branch (dgm:animOne `@val`).

VariantValue.description: JS-level variant value carried by a vt:* element.

VerticalAlignment.description: Vertical alignment of cell content; "distribute" spreads lines evenly across the cell height.

contentType.description: MIME content type of the linked video

creationId.description: a16:creationId `@id` from the cNvPr/docPr extension list — Office's per-object creation stamp, the sole known cNvPr ext content.

fileName.description: Media file name inside the package (ppt/media/<fileName>). Round-trip keeps the source name; fresh generation derives it from the frame name.

hidden.description: XSD `@hidden` (default false); emitted as "1" only when true.

mediaAction.description: Click-to-play hyperlink (a:hlinkClick `action="ppaction://media"` on p:cNvPr) — Office emits it on media frames.

trim.description: Play window trim of the p14:media extension copy (p14:trim, seconds). undefined = no trim child.

VideoType.description: Video container format of the media file.

ViewPropertiesOptions.description: Editing-view settings (p:viewPr — last active view, grid, guides, window panes).

guides.description: Slide-view guides (`p:guideLst`); each guide is a vertical or horizontal line at `pos` (EMU).

lastView.description: View active when the file was last saved; "slideSorterView" = the slide-overview grid.

notesView.description: Notes view (`p:notesViewPr`) — true emits the default empty view; an object carries its zoom/origin and its own guide list.

outlineView.description: Outline view (`p:outlineViewPr`) — view is its required `p:cViewPr`.

WebPropertiesOptions.description: Web output options (p:webPr — HTML export behavior).

WhenOptions.description: One alternative inside a choose — dgm:if; `if` is a reserved word.

argument.description: Function argument, usually a variable name (dgm:if `@arg`).

XYAdjustHandle.description: XY adjust handle. Allows the user to drag a handle in X/Y directions.

description: Options for generating a PresentationML (.pptx) file. Mirrors the PresentationOptions TypeScript interface of @office-open/pptx.
title: office-open PPTX presentation options
